issues.problem: Misattribution: because of the colon, the quoted sentence reads as something the police said. It is actually Korea JoongAng Daily's own lede: 'A self-taught coder and six accomplices allegedly used generative AI to hack some 90 organizations across Korea, stealing 8.2 million records and extorting victims for cash'. The police sentence in the article is: 'The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's cyber investigation division said Monday that it had apprehended the seven suspects, including the alleged ringleader, on charges including violations of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection and extortion.' Weekly covers are written from facts, so this could be reused as a police quote.
issues.fix: Rewrite facts[0] as: 'Korea JoongAng Daily lede (the paper's own words, not a police quote): "A self-taught coder and six accomplices allegedly used generative AI to hack some 90 organizations across Korea, stealing 8.2 million records and extorting victims for cash" (8.2 million, 8.2M). The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's cyber investigation division said Monday (Oct. 26, 2026) that it had apprehended the seven suspects, including the alleged ringleader, on charges including violations of the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection and extortion. No suspect is named in any of the three articles.'
